title: Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards Members on Ridgeline Pro Credit — Increase Percentage of a Credit Line Increase
content:
**Clause.** A Ridgeline Pro Credit line increase is worked on the current credit line at the increase percentage: the current credit line times the increase percentage, divided by one hundred. The increase percentage is set by the business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership and its ProBuild spend:

1. When the business holds an active ProBuild Gold, ProBuild Platinum or ProBuild Platinum Elite membership and its ProBuild qualifying spend posted in the last 12 months, net of spend reversed in the same 12 months, is at least **150000.00**, it is the tier's maximum increase percentage plus **10** percentage points.
2. When the business holds an active ProBuild Silver or higher membership (Silver, Gold, Platinum or Platinum Elite) with that net spend at least **50000.00**, and does not meet the first condition, it is the tier's maximum increase percentage plus **5** percentage points.
3. In every other case it is the tier's maximum increase percentage.

## Figures

| Tier | Maximum increase percentage | With the top addition | With the middle addition |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge | 25 | 35 | 30 |
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge Plus | 25 | 35 | 30 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 | 25 | 35 | 30 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 Select | 25 | 35 | 30 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 45 | 20 | 30 | 25 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 60 Enterprise | 15 | 25 | 20 |

The net spend is read from the spend and spend-reversal lines of the business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards activity, over the 12 whole calendar months counted back from the decision date. The membership is the business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership in active status, by its tier name.

## Cases (hypothetical, Commercial Account Net 45)

| Membership | Net spend in 12 months | Increase percentage |
|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Platinum | 150000.00 | 30 |
| ProBuild Platinum | 149999.99 | 25 |
| ProBuild Silver | 200000.00 | 25 |
| ProBuild Bronze | 200000.00 | 20 |
| ProBuild Gold | 40000.00 | 20 |
